title: Ship and debug a small service
outcome: Trace a failed request and explain configuration, timeouts, retries, and safe operation.

exercises.title: Find and fix the bug
exercises.prompt: A slow provider receives three retries for every request. Traffic doubles and the app stalls. Propose a first safe investigation and a lasting repair.

exercises.title: Change one condition
exercises.prompt: Finish the capstone, then explain it to a teammate without notes in five minutes. What evidence must your explanation include?

trace.title: Request ID
trace.detail: A useful service needs more than a happy-path endpoint. Ask how it starts, how you know it is healthy, how it behaves when a dependency slows down, and how you undo a release.

trace.title: Follow the middle steps
trace.detail:
Start with a reported symptom: POST /complete takes 12 seconds. Find the request ID, then time the database step and provider step. Check whether timeouts and retries explain the total duration. A bigger thread pool may only increase pressure on the slow dependency.

Release a database change in compatible steps when old and new app versions overlap. Keep a rollback path. A feature flag cannot undo data already deleted. Write a short runbook: symptom, check, safe action, verification.

trace.title: Check the result
trace.detail: Health endpoints may expose internals if published without access control. Retry loops can create a traffic storm. A benchmark with one request does not measure a saturated connection pool.

recallPrompt: Without notes: Trace a failed request and explain configuration, timeouts, retries, and safe operation. Give a concrete failure example.
